earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 dgx093020268-kex991.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Quest Diagnostics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results; Raises Revenue and EPS Guidance for Full Year 2026 • Third quarter revenues of $3.10 billion, up 10.0% from 2025, on strong organic revenue growth • Third quarter reported diluted earnings per share ("EPS") of $2.78, up 28.7% from 2025; and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.00, up 15.4% from 2025 • Full year 2026 revenues now expected to be between $12.065 billion and $12.105 billion • Full year 2026 reported diluted EPS now expected to be between $10.21 and $10.31; and adjusted diluted EPS expected to be between $11.25 and $11.35 SECAUCUS, N.J., October 22, 2026 - Quest Diagnostics Incorporated (NYSE: DGX), a leading provider of diagnostic information services, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “We delivered revenue growth of 10% and adjusted EPS growth of over 15% on continued strength across our physician, hospital and consumer channels, complemented by productivity gains from automation and AI,” said Jim Davis, Chairman, CEO and President. “Our robust organic revenue growth demonstrates that our solutions are fulfilling the expanding clinical care needs of an aging population as well as the increasing number of people focused on prevention and wellness. With these growth trends and our strong performance, we are raising our revenue and EPS guidance for the full year.” Recent Highlights: • Announced the ability for iPhone and iPad users in the United States to conveniently purchase a tailored Quest laboratory test panel with over 50 biomarkers directly through the Apple Health app, available to the public later this year. • Finalized a definitive agreement to acquire select outreach lab assets from a leading health system and long-time Co-Lab Solutions customer in the Northeastern U.S. Continued to advance our Co-Lab Solutions implementation and joint venture lab with Corewell Health in Michigan. • Extended our AD-Detect® menu to include the FDA-cleared Roche Elecsys® Phospho-Tau (217P) Plasma (pTau217) blood test and launched a new AD-Detect test panel with pTau217, amyloid beta and APOE to help guide diagnosis and treatment decisions for Alzheimer’s disease. • Advanced Project Nova from the design phase to the solutions-build phase and continue to expect to deploy Epic solutions in our first lab in the fall of 2027. The company will hold its 2027 Investor Day on March 25, 2027, at the New York Stock Exchange. Additional information will be provided closer to the event. 1 Three Months Ended September 30, Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026 2025 Change 2026 2025 Change (dollars in millions, except per share data) Reported: Net revenues $ 3,097 $ 2,816 10.0 % $ 9,035 $ 8,229 9.8 % Diagnostic Information Services revenues $ 3,035 $ 2,755 10.2 % $ 8,845 $ 8,043 10.0 % Revenue per requisition (4.2) % (2.8) % Requisition volume 14.5 % 12.9 % Organic requisition volume 14.4 % 12.8 % Operating income (a) $ 479 $ 386 24.2 % $ 1,337 $ 1,170 14.3 % Operating income as a percentage of net revenues (a) 15.5 % 13.7 % 1.8 % 14.8 % 14.2 % 0.6 % Net income attributable to Quest Diagnostics (a) $ 312 $ 245 27.6 % $ 884 $ 747 18.4 % Diluted EPS (a) $ 2.78 $ 2.16 28.7 % $ 7.86 $ 6.57 19.6 % Cash provided by operations $ 611 $ 563 8.8 % $ 1,486 $ 1,421 4.6 % Capital expenditures $ 166 $ 144 15.0 % $ 418 $ 369 13.2 % Adjusted (a): Operating income $ 517 $ 458 13.0 % $ 1,466 $ 1,330 10.3 % Operating income as a percentage of net revenues 16.7 % 16.3 % 0.4 % 16.2 % 16.2 % — % Net income attributable to Quest Diagnostics $ 338 $ 296 14.2 % $ 969 $ 845 14.7 % Diluted EPS $ 3.00 $ 2.60 15.4 % $ 8.62 $ 7.43 16.0 % (a) For further details impacting the year-over-year comparisons related to operating income, operating income as a percentage of net revenues, net income attributable to Quest Diagnostics, and diluted EPS, see note 2 of the financial tables attached below. Updated Guidance for Full Year 2026 The company updates its full year 2026 guidance as follows: Updated Guidance Prior Guidance Low High Low High Net revenues $12.065 billion $12.105 billion $11.95 billion $12.05 billion Net revenues increase 9.3% 9.7% 8.3% 9.2% Reported diluted EPS $10.21 $10.31 $9.97 $10.17 Adjusted diluted EPS $11.25 $11.35 $11.05 $11.25 Cash provided by operations Approximately $1.90 billion Approximately $1.80 billion Capital expenditures Approximately $550 million Approximately $550 million Note on Non-GAAP Financial Measures As used in this press release the term “reported” refers to measures under accounting principles generally accepted in the United States (“GAAP”). The term “adjusted” refers to non-GAAP operating performance measures that exclude special items such as restructuring and integration charges, amortization expense, excess tax benefits ("ETB") associated with stock-based compensation, gains and losses associated with changes in the carrying value of our strategic investments and other items. Non-GAAP adjusted measures are presented because management believes those measures are useful adjuncts to GAAP results. Non-GAAP adjusted measures should not be considered as an alternative to the corresponding measures determined under GAAP. Management may use these non-GAAP measures to evaluate our performance period over period and relative to competitors, to analyze the underlying trends in our business, to establish operational budgets and forecasts and for incentive compensation purposes. 2 We believe that these non-GAAP measures are useful to investors and analysts to evaluate our performance period over period and relative to competitors, as well as to analyze the underlying trends in our business and to assess our performance. The additional tables attached below include reconciliations of non-GAAP adjusted measures to GAAP measures. Conference Call Information Quest Diagnostics will hold its quarterly conference call to discuss financial results beginning at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time today. The conference call can be accessed by dialing 888-455-0391 within the U.S. and Canada, or 773-756-0467 internationally, passcode: 7895081; or via live webcast on our website at www.QuestDiagnostics.com/investor. We suggest participants dial in approximately 10 minutes before the call. A replay of the call may be accessed online at www.QuestDiagnostics.com/investor or, from approximately 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time on October 22, 2026 until midnight Eastern Time on November 5, 2026, by phone at 866-388-5361 for domestic callers or 203-369-0416 for international callers. Anyone listening to the call is encouraged to read our periodic reports, on file with the Securities and Exchange Commission, including the discussion of risk factors and historical results of operations and financial condition in those reports. About Quest Diagnostics Quest Diagnostics works across healthcare to create a healthier world, one life at a time. We help connect people, from clinicians to consumers, with laboratory insights that illuminate a path to better health. With a focus on delivering smarter, simpler testing, our insights reveal new avenues to identify and treat disease, inspire healthy behaviors and improve healthcare management. Quest Diagnostics serves half the physicians and hospitals in the United States and one in three adult Americans each year, and our nearly 60,000 employees work together to deliver diagnostic insights that inspire actions to transform lives. www.QuestDiagnostics.com. Readers are cautioned not to place undue reliance on forward-looking statements, which speak only as of the date that they are made and which reflect management’s current estimates, projections, expectations or beliefs and which involve risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results and outcomes to be materially different. reference.summary: Quest Diagnostics Incorporated provides diagnostic testing and services in the United States. The company develops and delivers diagnostic information services, such as routine, non-routine and advanced clinical testing, anatomic pathology testing, and other diagnostic information services. It also provides services under the Quest Diagnostics brand, as well as under the AmeriPath, Dermpath Diagnostics, ExamOne, and Quanum brands to physicians, hospitals, patients and consumers, health plans, government agencies, employers, retailers, pharmaceutical companies and insurers commercial clinical laboratories, and accountable care organizations through a network of laboratories, patient service centers, phlebotomists in physician offices, call centers and mobile phlebotomists, nurses, and other health and wellness professionals.
